name: arbiter
description: The Claude Code plugin for Arbiter, a local file converter. Arbiter（调律者转换器）的 Claude Code 插件。

plugins.name: arbiter
plugins.description: Format conversion — video, audio, image, document, PDF, ebook and archive — with eight MCP tools (inspect_file / convert_file / batch_convert / get_job_status / list_jobs / cancel_job / list_supported_formats / read_document) and four commands: /arbiter:convert, /arbiter:formats, /arbiter:watch, /arbiter:update. Two hooks: PreToolUse(Read) converts a .docx to temporary Markdown before the Read happens (it rewrites, never blocks), and SessionStart mentions a new version once per session (silent when offline or up to date). The plugin ships no engines — it uses the Arbiter app already installed on your machine. 格式转换：视频 / 音频 / 图片 / 文档 / PDF / 电子书 / 压缩包互转。自带八个 MCP 工具与四个命令；另有两个 hook：PreToolUse(Read) 在 Read 一个 .docx 时自动先转成临时 Markdown（只改写、从不拦截），SessionStart 在新会话时轻量提一句有没有新版本（没网/没新版一律静默）。插件不含引擎，借用本机已安装的 Arbiter 应用。
